_comment: Pterodactyl egg for ghcr.io/godstepx/docker-hytale-server (bundled Hytale Downloader CLI)
name: Hytale (Docker, bundled CLI)
author: godstepx + LordSalkin
description: Runs ghcr.io/godstepx/docker-hytale-server with the bundled Hytale Downloader CLI, OAuth device login, and persistent data under /home/container (mapped to /data).

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -e
# Image already contains the server binaries and downloader CLI.
mkdir -p /home/container

variables.name: Server Port (UDP)
variables.description: Port allocation used by the server. Must be a UDP allocation in Pterodactyl.

variables.name: Bind Address
variables.description: Address to bind. Keep 0.0.0.0 for Pterodactyl.

variables.name: Download Mode
variables.description: How server files are obtained: auto, cli, launcher, or manual.

variables.name: Patchline
variables.description: release or pre-release patchline for downloads.

variables.name: Data Directory
variables.description: Where persistent data is stored. Pterodactyl mounts /home/container; map it to /data internally.

variables.name: Max Heap (XMX)
variables.description: Maximum JVM heap. Defaults to panel memory value.

variables.name: Auto Auth On Start
variables.description: Start OAuth device login automatically when no tokens are cached.

variables.name: Check Updates
variables.description: Check for newer server files on startup (cli mode).

variables.name: Owner UUID (optional)
variables.description: Profile UUID when passing tokens manually.

variables.name: Session Token (optional)
variables.description: Pre-provisioned session token to skip device auth.

variables.name: Identity Token (optional)
variables.description: Pre-provisioned identity token to skip device auth.
